title: papaver rhoeas subsp. insignitum
intro: Papaver rhoeas subsp. insignitum, commonly known as Corn Poppy or Flanders Poppy, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the Papaver family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including aiding in digestion and reducing inflammation, making it a popular choice for treating various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Papaver rhoeas subsp. insignitum are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and exert anti-inflammatory effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds and other respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
